title: Verwijzing naar de data van: Guardianship in action - Residential Guardianship
descriptions: This project attempts to disentangle concepts of Newman's defensible space theory in order to highlight some of the conceptual issues that may pose problems for measurement, as well as which concepts hold the most promise for developing our understanding of guardianship in action at micro-places. The end result will be an integrated theoretical framework to explain the main contextual factors that affect guardianship. Observation dataset containing risk and protective factors for homes in multiple neighborhoods in The Hague.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]
